item.name: Policy — Detection-time outcomes
item.description: Coverage for the canonical PolicyMatchService::match decision table (entity-publication-policies §3). Exercises the four outcomes — no-match (WOO default), prohibition-only, standing-consent-only, and both-match (prohibition wins). Each item that seeds a policy record cleans it up afterwards so the suite is idempotent across re-runs. Group-permission failures (403/500) are accepted by the seed POSTs because the test environment may not configure the docudesk-policy-admins / docudesk-standing-consent-admins groups; subsequent assertions are skipped when seeding fails.

item.name: no-match: POST /api/consent → WOO default (pending across the board)

exec: if (pm.response.code === 500 || pm.response.code === 400) { pm.test.skip('Consent register/schema not configured in this env'); return; }
pm.test('matchKind is null (no rule fired)', function () { pm.expect(json.matchKind).to.satisfy(function (v) { return v === null || v === undefined; }); });
pm.test('policyMatch is null', function () { pm.expect(json.policyMatch).to.satisfy(function (v) { return v === null || v === undefined; }); });

item.name: prohibition: SEED publicationProhibition for Newman Detect Prohibition Subject

body.raw: {"primaryName":"Newman Detect Prohibition Subject","entityType":"PERSON","reason":"Newman integration test fixture (detection-time prohibition outcome)","matchRules":[{"type":"exact","value":"Newman Detect Prohibition Subject"}],"active":true}

exec: if (pm.response.code === 403 || pm.response.code === 500) { pm.collectionVariables.set('detectionProhibitionSeeded', 'false'); pm.test.skip('Seeding requires docudesk-policy-admins group; not configured in env'); return; }
if (pm.collectionVariables.get('detectionProhibitionSeeded') !== 'true') { pm.test.skip('Seed step skipped — cannot exercise outcome'); return; }
if (pm.response.code === 500 || pm.response.code === 400) { pm.test.skip('Consent register/schema not configured'); return; }
if (pm.collectionVariables.get('detectionProhibitionSeeded') !== 'true') { pm.test.skip('No seed to clean'); return; }
pm.test('Cleanup deleted seeded prohibition', function () { pm.expect([200, 204, 404]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

if (pm.response.code === 403 || pm.response.code === 500) { pm.collectionVariables.set('detectionStandingSeeded', 'false'); pm.test.skip('Seeding requires docudesk-standing-consent-admins group; not configured in env'); return; }
if (pm.collectionVariables.get('detectionStandingSeeded') !== 'true') { pm.test.skip('Seed step skipped — cannot exercise outcome'); return; }
if (pm.response.code === 500 || pm.response.code === 400) { pm.test.skip('Consent register/schema not configured'); return; }
